neighbours.label: the word pieces of 'greet' and 'reverberate' and the word ' idle' (a list; no shared pattern found)
fire: Every morning our doorman greets the tenants with a small nod and a smile.
At the gate, the old priest greets each pilgrim by name before the service.
On stage the singer greets her fans and thanks them for coming out tonight.
Thunder would reverberate between the canyon walls for almost a minute afterwards.
Inside the cathedral, each footstep seemed to reverberate off the cold stone floor.
His angry words continued to reverberate around the small meeting room for days.
Most of the delivery trucks stayed idle in the yard during the long strike.
With no orders coming in, the factory machines were left idle until next spring.

His angry words continued to circulate around the small meeting room for days.
Most of the delivery trucks stayed parked in the yard during the long strike.
With no orders coming in, the factory machines were left unused until next spring.
